1084-2403-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-2403-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-2403-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2317-3899-6664-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

2279-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
2279-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

141-2292-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-1893-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-5686.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-728-3375-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

824-2511-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2511-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2511-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

413-628-7189.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Dread Tiller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2921-4875-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2921-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

436-4264-5220.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {2}{G}{U}.
Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Altered Ego dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Altered Ego from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Altered Ego onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-2034-2919-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-2034-2919-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

141-2596-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2596-5147.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

277-3470-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
277-3470-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko, Tiller Engine and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2173-2448-5220-6578.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-6578.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
2173-2448-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

539-2921-3045-3293.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-2921-3045-3293.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-2921-3045-3293.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

1479-3257-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-6529.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

11-1744-5195-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-1744-5195-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Rite of Replication by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Rite of Replication, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Rite of Replication, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Rite of Replication
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Rite of Replication.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Rite of Replication to your hand and creating a copy of Rite of Replication targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rite of Replication copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Rite of Replication.
Repeat from step 3.

411-2054-2440.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
When Grinning Ignus enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

1170-3363-5078-6289.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

277-1170-1645-5334-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-1633-2039-3809-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Torrential Gearhulk is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-2039-3809-5195.description:
Activate Torrential Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Torrential Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Torrential Gearhulk.
Resolve a Torrential Gearhulk trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

719-2569-3957-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
"Merfolk" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2569-3957-4289.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2703-2816-4659-5149.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle and Power Artifact attached to Myr Propagator.
Myr Propagator does not have summoning sickness.
2703-2816-4659-5149.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

841-2292-4488-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2292-4488-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Beast token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Beast, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

2584-3197-5017.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Urban Daggertooth indestructible.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
2584-3197-5017.description:
Give Urban Daggertooth indestructible.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, dealing 4 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

45-614-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
45-614-1987-3075.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
